# bintables/dot

> Field access: the struct pointer plus the field's offset; 1- or 8-byte load.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/dot.pkg) · translates [std/dot](../std/dot.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when self size 1`

```nasm
{obj}
movzx eax, byte [rax+{f.offset}]
```

### `emit`

```nasm
{obj}
mov rax, [rax+{f.offset}]
```

### `emit addr`

```nasm
{obj}
add rax, {f.offset}
```
